1.title: Distill the LLM, Don't Serve It: Search & Personalization at DoorDash — Raghav Saboo, DoorDash
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: LLM reasoning done offline, distilled into small fast models for serving — with four named primitives (LLM supervision, semantic IDs, consumer memory, steerable generation) and specific results (2.3% NDCG, 4–5% MRR, ~1% order rate lift).
